note: NECO Civic Education Paper III round 1: fresh SSCE-standard items across the civic education curriculum - values, citizenship and nationalism, national symbols, human rights, law and order, responsible parenthood, traffic regulations, cultism, drugs and drug abuse, HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, youth restiveness and empowerment, national unity, and political apathy. Nigerian agencies (FRSC, LASTMA, NDLEA, NAFDAC, SON, NHRC, NAPTIP, NYSC) and current facts (2024 national anthem change) included. Civic Education is compulsory for every SSCE candidate.
